name: Finset.mulEnergy'_mono_left
statement: @[to_additive] lemma mulEnergy'_mono_left (hs : s₁ ⊆ s₂) : Eₘ[s₁, t] ≤ Eₘ[s₂, t]

name: Finset.mulEnergy'_mono_right
statement: @[to_additive] lemma mulEnergy'_mono_right (ht : t₁ ⊆ t₂) : Eₘ[s, t₁] ≤ Eₘ[s, t₂]

name: IsMulSidon.empty
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /-- The empty set is additively Sidon. -/]
protected theorem IsMulSidon.empty : IsMulSidon (∅ : Set G)

name: IsMulSidon.iUnion
statement:
@[to_additive /-- A directed union of additively Sidon sets is additively Sidon. -/]
protected theorem IsMulSidon.iUnion {ι : Sort*} {A : ι → Set G} (hA : Directed (· ⊆ ·) A)
    (h : ∀ i, IsMulSidon (A i)) : IsMulSidon (⋃ i, A i)

name: IsMulSidon.mono
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := gcongr) /-- A subset of an additively Sidon set is additively Sidon. -/]
theorem IsMulSidon.mono (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hB : IsMulSidon B) : IsMulSidon A

name: IsMulSidon.of_subsingleton
statement:
@[to_additive /-- A subsingleton set is additively Sidon. -/]
protected theorem IsMulSidon.of_subsingleton (hA : A.Subsingleton) : IsMulSidon A

name: IsMulSidon.pair
statement:
@[to_additive /-- A pair in a torsion-free group is additively Sidon. -/]
protected theorem IsMulSidon.pair (a b : G) : IsMulSidon ({a, b} : Set G)

name: IsMulSidon.sUnion
statement:
@[to_additive /-- A directed union of additively Sidon sets is additively Sidon. -/]
protected theorem IsMulSidon.sUnion {S : Set (Set G)} (hS : DirectedOn (· ⊆ ·) S)
    (h : ∀ A ∈ S, IsMulSidon A) : IsMulSidon (⋃₀ S)

name: IsMulSidon.singleton
statement:

protected theorem IsMulSidon.singleton (a : G) : IsMulSidon ({a} : Set G)

name: Finset.cast_dens_inter
statement: lemma cast_dens_inter : ((s ∩ t).dens : K) = s.dens + t.dens - (s ∪ t).dens

name: Finset.cast_dens_sdiff
statement: lemma cast_dens_sdiff (h : s ⊆ t) : ((t \ s).dens : K) = t.dens - s.dens

name: Finset.cast_dens_union
statement: lemma cast_dens_union : ((s ∪ t).dens : K) = s.dens + t.dens - (s ∩ t).dens

name: Finset.dens_product
statement: @[simp] lemma dens_product (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) : (s ×ˢ t).dens = s.dens * t.dens

name: Finset.dens_sdiff_of_subset
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma dens_sdiff_of_subset (h : s ⊆ t) : (t \ s).dens = t.dens - s.dens

name: Finset.dens_union_eq_dens_add_dens
statement: lemma dens_union_eq_dens_add_dens : (s ∪ t).dens = s.dens + t.dens ↔ Disjoint s t
